ios.desc:
Split expenses and manage shared funds with friends, family, roommates, partners, or travel groups. No more awkward conversations, messy spreadsheets, or “who owes who?” drama. Splito keeps everything fair, transparent, and stress-free.

Perfect for vacation trips, dinners, events, shared homes, and everyday spending.

Why People Love Splito
 - Split bills instantly - no calculators, no confusion
 - Track all shared expenses in one place
 - Always know who owes whom
 - Settle up easily with simple, clear balances
 - Works great for trips, roommates, couples, and groups
 - 100% transparency - everyone sees the same numbers

Great For Every Situation
 - Group trips & vacations – flights, food, fuel, stays, activities
 - Roommates – rent, groceries, utilities, shared cabs, household costs
 - Couples – date nights, bills, subscriptions, vacation trips
 - Friends at dinners or outings – quick check splits
 - Events & celebrations – parties, gifts, farewell, contributions
 - Shared budgets – savings pools, group funds, club collections
 - For NGOs, societies, and clubs - complete transparency that protects trust and relationships.
 - Gifts, games, parties, rides — split anything with friends in seconds.

Top Features
 - Split bills instantly (equal or custom split)
 - Track shared expenses for groups, trips, or households
 - Know exactly who owes whom
 - Settle up with clear balances
 - Add multiple payers & uneven splits
 - Add repeat expenses like rent, subscriptions, easily
 - Manage funds with your child, spouse, or friends
 - Scan Receipt and add expenses
 - Itemization expense tracking
 - Charts and Graphs for better visuals
 - Save default split for hassle free experience
 - Export data in easy to read format
 - Track funds for NGOs, societies, or clubs with complete transparency
 - Track and manage your personal expenses with a fund group
 - Clean, fast, and easy to use

Transparent, Private & Secure
Your data stays safe and accessible only to you and your groups. No surprises, no confusion — just clean, accurate expense tracking.

Terms of Use: https://splito.canopas.com/terms-of-service

Questions or Feedback? Reach out to us at https://splito.canopas.com/

quotes.text:
Introducing Splito - An open-source iOS app designed to simplify group expense management!

Have you ever found yourself in a confusing situation after a night out with friends or a weekend trip, trying to figure out who owes what? Splito aims to eliminate that hassle.

Key Features:

- Effortless expense tracking

- Flexible bill splitting options

- Support for multiple payers

- Transparent transaction history

We built Splito to make sharing costs easy and stress-free, allowing you to focus on enjoying your time with friends and family instead of worrying about finances.

Check it out on the

App Store - https://apps.apple.com/app/id6477442217

GitHub - https://github.com/canopas/splito.

We'd love to hear your thoughts! What features would you like to see next? Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to improve this project.

quotes.text:
Simplify group expense management with Splito, the ultimate open-source solution to track, split, and settle shared costs seamlessly.

Why Choose Splito?

Splito makes managing group expenses with friends, family, or colleagues effortless:

- Group Trips

- Shared Household Bills

- Event Planning

Features You'll Love:

- Create and manage groups for expense tracking.

- Split costs fairly and settle payments effortlessly.

- View transaction history and recover deleted data.

- Receive reminders for unpaid balances.

Download Now & Start Splitting Fairly!

https://apps.apple.com/in/app/splito-split-enjoy-together/id6477442217

Exciting Upcoming Features

- Multi-currency support and group wallets.

- Spending charts, group reports, and public polls.

- Comments on expenses to add notes to transactions.

We’d love to hear your thoughts to help us make it even better!

Explore the Project!

https://github.com/canopas/splito
